title: Person down near platform edge
summary: Pose detector observed a person transition from standing to prone near the platform edge marker [SIG-1040]. No recovery motion was detected for 14 s [SIG-1041], and zone D density remained low enough for direct staff access.
sop: Dispatch nearest platform staff to zone D with medical kit.
Hold approaching train if the person remains near the edge marker.
Confirm whether emergency services are required before dismissing.

vlm.description: A person appears low to the ground near the platform boundary while nearby foot traffic is sparse.

signals.detail: vertical pose height collapsed from 152 px to 42 px

signals.transcript: Dispatch medical assistance to platform two, north end.
